scope: Frozen public candidate pools + cached historical real Qwen scores + fresh Decision calls. No live KB recall or answer-quality evaluation.
selection: First 12 test cases in frozen file order with >10 candidates and successful historical Qwen receipt. Selection does not inspect qrels or model predictions.
baseline_policy: Same production coarse selection/fusion/top10 using cached Qwen response; no modification of original evidence or receipts.
candidate_policy: Production assist: at most8 remaining text candidates, full bounded content, at most2 additions with >=0.85 Choice confidence/probability.
metrics: recall before/after over same fixed pool
default_policy: Remain opt-in; no default/config mutation; no quality claim solely from functional tests.
